value.message: Enter the details for this connection. Learn more about
OAuth - Resource Owner Password Credentials Grant.
Enter the name of the service provider you want to integrate with. Example: Microsoft, Google, Zoom, SAP, etc
A client ID is used to identify the application.
A client secret is a secret key known only to the application and the authorization server. This key used to authenticate the application and obtain access tokens.

The Enforce token restriction option limits the client to accessing only the APIs specified in the REST API Access Policies. If you unselect it, the client can access other REST APIs based on the user ACL permissions.
Field on sys_user to populate value in the sub claim of JWT Access Token
The field lifespan is the time in seconds and represents the duration for which an access token remains valid after it is issued. Default value is: 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
The field lifespan is the time in seconds and represents the duration for which a refresh token remains valid after it is issued. Default value is: 8,640,000 seconds (100 days).
Are you sure you want to create the OAuth client without an auth scope? Assign an auth scope now to ensure appropriate authorization and security, or assign it later.
